what: A character fixed to the screen walks left together with the content by the scrolled distance, then stops and waits at 2vw from the left of the screen. When scrolling back, it turns around (rotateY 180) in .3s power1.inOut, walks right and stops at 2vw from the right. Each time the left edge of a designated section crosses a horizontal ratio line of the screen (.4·.3·.2), the character folds to 90° in .2s power1.in, then unfolds from −90° in .2s power1.out as the next character, and scrolling back returns the previous one. On narrow screens, when it overlaps a card or table, it turns sideways (90°) and hides. It is a guide for horizontally flowing scroll-roll pages.

options.speed: Distance in px traveled per 1px of scroll, default 1 — the content travels along when the horizontal stage moves 1:1 with scroll
options.flip: Duration of folding or unfolding (sec), default .2 — twice that when switching
options.edge: Which edge of a section counts as crossed — left (default, horizontal stage) · top (vertical page)
options.avoid: (if present) css of the element hidden on overlap — card·table
options.avoid-below: Window width (px) at or below which hiding turns on, default 767
options.[data-fx-part=look]: Character illustrations (if two or more, they swap in turn). From the second, data-key="#Section" · data-ratio=".4" — when that section crosses the line, this character
options.[data-fx-part=dir]: Layer that turns away — whole element if none
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Fold layer that opens and closes — if none, the first character’s parent
options.[data-fx-part=hide]: (If present) Layer that turns sideways and hides when overlapping

note: Walks by the change in scroll position — window scroll (including Lenis) as is, or data-fx-scroller for an inner panel. On the horizontal stage (brand), Lenis takes the vertical wheel as window scroll and the stage moves left by that same amount, so the walking distance equals the content movement.

from.where: shared.js .walker — sticks to the screen and walks along, stops at 2vw, turns around when scrolling back, and flips at the concept·how to enjoy·overview section boundaries (.4·.3·.2) while the character changes. On phones it hides over cards
